tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground. Also the fill of forms and callouts that sit on forest or ink bands.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The alternating white band (always with a line hairline above and below) and the fill of text fields.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on paper, surface, stone and the three tints (16:1 on paper). Ground of ink bands, code panels and the outline button's border.

tokens.name: ink-body
tokens.usage: Running body copy on paper, surface, stone and the three tints (8:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: captions, breadcrumbs, metadata, fine print, on paper and surface (6.3:1).

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: The 1px ink rule that opens a list, table or card group. Always paired with line hairlines between rows.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and around white bands on paper and surface. Decorative only; never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: field-border
tokens.usage: Border of text fields and textareas (3.1:1 on paper, 3.3:1 on surface).

tokens.name: placeholder
tokens.usage: Placeholder text inside fields (5.4:1 on surface). Placeholders never replace a label.

tokens.name: stone
tokens.usage: Inline code fill, neutral tags and the neutral card fill. Ink and ink-body text read on it.

tokens.name: stone-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for inactive tabs on surface.

tokens.name: tint-line
tokens.usage: Hairlines inside tinted cards (ink at 15%), so they read on every tint.

tokens.name: cobalt
tokens.usage: Brand color A, 'who can see'. Utility bar, primary button, first brand block. As text on paper or surface (6.0:1) and on cobalt-tint (5.4:1).

tokens.name: cobalt-deep
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of the primary button.

tokens.name: cobalt-tint
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind cobalt text: cobalt cards and 'who can see' layer rows.

tokens.name: on-cobalt
tokens.usage: Text on a cobalt fill (utility bar, cobalt panels), 5.5:1.

tokens.name: cobalt-line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows on a cobalt fill.

tokens.name: forest
tokens.usage: Brand color B, 'what they get'. Links, eyebrows, section indices, the active tab, forest bands. As text on paper (6.0:1), surface (6.5:1) and forest-tint (5.5:1).

tokens.name: forest-tint
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind forest text: forest cards and the highlighted Provisa column of comparison tables.

tokens.name: on-forest
tokens.usage: Body copy on forest bands (5.5:1). Headings on forest use on-accent.

tokens.name: on-forest-muted
tokens.usage: Eyebrows, indices and small labels on forest bands and on the active forest tab (5.0:1).

tokens.name: forest-line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows on forest bands.

tokens.name: forest-rule
tokens.usage: The rule that opens a list on a forest band (the forest counterpart of rule).

tokens.name: forest-bright
tokens.usage: Forest accent on ink: section indices, rules and check marks in code on ink bands (8.9:1).

tokens.name: vermilion
tokens.usage: Brand color C, 'whether it runs'. Emphasis inside display type, stat numerals, figure blocks and accent rules. As text only at 24px and up (3.7:1 on paper).

tokens.name: vermilion-deep
tokens.usage: Vermilion for anything smaller than 24px: eyebrows, mono labels and indices on paper, surface or vermilion-tint (4.6:1 or better). Also the ground of vermilion bands and pills that carry white text (5.5:1).

tokens.name: vermilion-tint
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind vermilion-deep text: vermilion cards and 'whether it runs' layer rows.

tokens.name: vermilion-light
tokens.usage: Vermilion accent on ink: mono labels such as PLAN OUT, and strings in code (9.9:1).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and marks on cobalt, forest, vermilion-deep and ink fills: buttons, pills, active tabs, band headings.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on ink bands.

tokens.name: on-ink-body
tokens.usage: Body copy on ink bands (10.5:1).

tokens.name: on-ink-muted
tokens.usage: Small secondary text on ink bands (7.0:1).

tokens.name: ink-line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows on ink bands.

tokens.name: code-ground
tokens.usage: Ground of code panels on paper, surface and tints.

tokens.name: code-ground-deep
tokens.usage: Ground of code panels that sit on an ink band, so the panel still separates.

tokens.name: code-line
tokens.usage: Borders inside code panels: the tab bar and the header strip.

tokens.name: code-text
tokens.usage: Code text on code-ground and code-ground-deep.

tokens.name: code-comment
tokens.usage: Comments in code (4.5:1 on ink). Never used on light grounds.

tokens.name: code-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for inactive tabs on a code panel.

tokens.name: code-tab-text
tokens.usage: Label of an inactive tab on a code panel (11:1).

tokens.name: code-tab-meta
tokens.usage: Wire-protocol caption of an inactive tab on a code panel (5.5:1).

tokens.name: code-highlight
tokens.usage: Background of a line that governance injected into a query (vermilion at 28%). Text on it is on-accent.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Source Serif 4 with its optical-size axis: large sizes draw the display cut automatically. Headings are semibold (600) with negative tracking. Sizes are the desktop maximum; the matching fluid-* token scales them down.

styles.name: t-display-xl
styles.sample: Query the data you already have.
styles.usage: The home hero headline only. Fluid: fluid-display-xl.

styles.name: t-display
styles.sample: Six layers, compiled into the plan.
styles.usage: Inner page hero headline, one per page. Fluid: fluid-display.

styles.name: t-cta
styles.sample: Describe your data and govern it in the same act.
styles.usage: The contact band headline. Fluid: fluid-cta.

styles.name: t-h2-xl
styles.sample: Keep your tools. All of them.
styles.usage: Home page section headings. Fluid: fluid-h2-xl.

styles.name: t-h2
styles.usage: Inner page section headings. Fluid: fluid-h2.

styles.name: t-h3-xl
styles.usage: Headings of long-form items, such as each governance layer. Fluid: fluid-h3-xl.

styles.name: t-h3-lg
styles.sample: Swap the engine. Keep everything else.
styles.usage: Sub-section headings inside a band. Fluid: fluid-h3-lg.

styles.name: t-h3
styles.usage: Headings of large cards and panels.

styles.name: t-h4
styles.usage: Card titles, protocol names, resource titles.

styles.name: t-h5
styles.usage: Titles inside dense grids: pillars, steps, flow columns.

styles.name: t-serif-md
styles.sample: Is Provisa a database, or does it replace my warehouse?
styles.usage: Regular-weight serif lines: FAQ questions, accordion titles, list rows, download names.

styles.name: t-numeral
styles.usage: Stat numerals and big step numbers, colored with a brand color.

styles.name: t-numeral-xl
styles.usage: Index numerals beside long-form items (governance layers). Fluid: fluid-numeral-xl.

styles.name: t-lead-serif-lg
styles.usage: The one serif lead paragraph that opens a home section. Fluid: fluid-lead-serif-lg.

styles.name: t-lead-serif
styles.sample: A JOIN is legal only if it matches a registered relationship.
styles.usage: A serif pull paragraph inside an inner page section. Fluid: fluid-lead-serif.

styles.name: t-caption
styles.sample: The federated model, explorable as a live graph.
styles.usage: Figure captions under screenshots, in ink-muted.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Public Sans for everything that is read rather than scanned. Body copy sits at 16.5px with generous leading; keep measure at or under 720px.

styles.name: t-lede
styles.sample: Provisa sits on top of the databases, warehouses, and files you already run.
styles.usage: The paragraph under a hero headline. Fluid: fluid-lede.

styles.name: t-lead
styles.sample: One governed path for analytical, application, and human data movement.
styles.usage: The line under the contact band headline.

styles.name: t-body-lg
styles.sample: All six are applied while the query is compiled.
styles.usage: Section body copy, in ink-body.

styles.name: t-body
styles.sample: Your data stays where it is.
styles.usage: Card and panel copy.

styles.name: t-body-sm
styles.usage: Dense copy: list rows, table-like groups, form help.

styles.name: t-fine
styles.usage: Fine print and license text, in ink-muted.

styles.name: t-ui
styles.usage: Navigation, medium buttons and ruled links.

styles.name: t-ui-lg
styles.usage: Large buttons in heroes and forms.

styles.name: t-eyebrow
styles.usage: Section labels above headings. Always uppercase.

styles.name: t-label
styles.usage: Labels inside cards and panels. Always uppercase.

groups.name: Code
groups.note: IBM Plex Mono for code, indices, wire-protocol names and figure labels.

styles.name: t-code
styles.usage: Code blocks.

styles.name: t-mono
styles.usage: Section indices, step numbers, protocol meta.

styles.name: t-mono-sm
styles.usage: Diagram headers, protocol chips, code chips.

styles.name: t-mono-xs
styles.usage: Figure labels and code panel captions.

spacing.note: Named by pixel value. Layout gaps come from this list; section rhythm comes from the fluid-* tokens.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between the three logo bars and between stacked tags.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between rows of a stack diagram.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between tags; inside compact chips.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Between a section index and its label; inside chips.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between buttons; between related lines.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Between a figure and its caption; ruled list row padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Card grid gutters for tinted cards; list row padding.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Space under a card's top rule before its title.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Between paragraphs in a section body.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Inside code panels; between a heading and its body.

tokens.name: space-28
tokens.usage: Inside tinted cards; between a hero eyebrow, headline and lede.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Gutters between ruled cards.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Between a section header and its content.

tokens.name: space-56
tokens.usage: Between the columns of a hero or split section.

tokens.name: space-64
tokens.usage: Between the rail and the content of an editorial section.

tokens.name: space-72
tokens.usage: Column gap of split section headers; footer top padding.

radius.note: Square. Corners are 0 everywhere except the switch track and circles.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Every button, card, field, panel and figure.

tokens.name: radius-switch
tokens.usage: The switch track only (half its 24px height).

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Circles: the switch knob and dot figures.

border.note: Rules do the work shadows do elsewhere: a 1px ink rule opens a group, line hairlines divide its rows, and thick brand-colored rules mark a card's category.

tokens.name: border-hair
tokens.usage: Hairlines and the ink rule that opens a group.

tokens.name: border-heavy
tokens.usage: The ink rule above a comparison table.

tokens.name: border-accent
tokens.usage: Top rule of a language card.

tokens.name: border-bar
tokens.usage: Top rule of a principle card, colored by its brand color.

tokens.name: border-block
tokens.usage: Top rule of a tinted card, left bar of a layer row, top edge of a code panel.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the content container, gutters included.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum width of running body copy.

tokens.name: measure-lede
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a hero lede.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Height of the sticky site header.

fluid.note: Viewport-scaled values. Type sizes pair with the Display styles; spacing sets the vertical rhythm of bands.

tokens.name: fluid-gutter
tokens.usage: Side padding of the container at every width.

tokens.name: fluid-section-y
tokens.usage: Top and bottom padding of a band.

tokens.name: fluid-section-y-lg
tokens.usage: Padding of the numbered editorial bands on the home page.

tokens.name: fluid-hero-top
tokens.usage: Space above the home hero headline.

tokens.name: fluid-hero-bottom
tokens.usage: Space below any hero.

tokens.name: fluid-page-hero-top
tokens.usage: Space above an inner page's breadcrumb.

tokens.name: fluid-hero-gap
tokens.usage: Between a hero's headline block and its body.

tokens.name: fluid-panel-pad
tokens.usage: Inner padding of the demo form and tab panels.
